candidate_rules.nearest_physical_f0: Minimum absolute frequency minus physical F0, excluding DC
candidate_rules.strongest_near_physical_f0: Maximum saved amplitude among positive frequencies in [0.5*F0,1.5*F0]

scope: All selected compact-DVQM samples after real resource/control/loadSample, before sampleInfo/config/audio; loaded state hashed before and after read-only comparisons. The DC phase slot is excluded. Three preset physical phase selectors and both signs, direct or capped steps, and trapezoidal F0 advance using loaded frame timestamps; the first-eight-phase rotation is a separate diagnostic, not a producer. The normalized step rate uses an assumed 256-sample/44100-Hz reference only as a diagnostic, not a recovered maker hop. Loaded timestamps vary and their original time-warp is not recovered. Catalog entries are not asserted to be independent recordings. No PCM analysis, original production inputs or formal bit17 name assertion. Separate from V4X Growl and auxiliary TENSE/BRWSP resources.
